project_goal: Prove Work Unit eligibility without building a product.
definition_of_done: All eligible synthetic units reach deterministic terminal states

work_units.title: Bootstrap eligibility
work_units.objective: Establish the root Work Unit with no dependencies.
work_units.context: Harmless synthetic fixture. No product implementation.

work_units.title: Depend on W001
work_units.objective: Become READY only after W001 is DONE.
acceptance_criteria: W002 is not selected before W001

work_units.title: Independent sibling of W002
work_units.objective: Become READY after W001 without waiting for W002.
acceptance_criteria: W003 may run after W001 even if W002 failed

work_units.title: Depend on W002
work_units.objective: Remain blocked if W002 is not DONE.
test_requirements: State machine records BLOCKED when W002 fails

work_units.title: Depend on W003
work_units.objective: Become READY only after W003 is DONE.
test_requirements: Injected submitter records W005 after W003
